author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
Researchers at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems in Germany have developed a robot capable of hovering in mid-air with no propellers and no engine, relying instead on four flaps that subtly change how air moves around it. 

Source Article: https://www.nature.com/articles/s44182-026-00086-z
